describes: the Events view: for each event of data/seed/events.json, the cracks, the margin after gas and utilisation from six months before its month to six months after, with every missing month named
source: the committed caches in data/cache and data/seed, the manifest, and data/private/ei_refinery_capacity_annual for utilisation only; no network

conventions.missing: A missing value is JSON null. null never means zero and is never drawn as zero or bridged; the page shows a gap and says why.
conventions.rounding: Floats are stored to 6 places. The page prints the decimals of the format a value names.
conventions.segments: A sentence is a list of segments. A text segment holds words only. A value segment names its field and holds a value with a format, or an ISO date or a word with its label.

title_segments.text: What the cracks, the margin after gas and utilisation did from

lead_segments.text: Each panel shows levels around a dated event, in the source's own units: what moved around the date, never an estimate of the event's effect, because other things happened in the same months. Every window runs the full
months; a month a series does not cover is left empty and named, never filled.
